sloka: मरणान्तानि वैराणि निर्वृत्तं नः प्रयोजनम् ।क्रियतामस्य संस्कारो ममाप्येष यथा तव ।। ६.११४.१०१ ।।
transliteration: maraṇāntāni vairāṇi nirvṛttaṁ naḥ prayojanam ।kriyatāmasya saṁskāro mamāpyeṣa yathā tava ।। 6.114.101 ।।

translations.english: "Though he is richly endowed with prowess, he is a tyranny to the world, who has performed a hundred sacrifices (like Indra) and never got defeated, I heard."
